units.source_text: 源氏大将对于六条妃子下伊势之事，并不坚决反对。

en.t: General Genji did not firmly oppose Lady Rokujo's decision to go down to Ise.

units.source_text: 只是对她说道：“我固然毫不足道，被你摒弃，也是理之当然。

en.t: He merely said to her, "I am, of course, of no account, and it is only natural that you should cast me aside.

units.source_text: 不过既结此缘，虽无可取，总希望长此存续，有始有终。”

en.t: Yet since we have formed this bond, worthless though I may be, I still hope it will continue for a long time and reach its proper end."

units.source_text: 这是不着边际的话，因此六条妃子行止难于决定。

en.t: These words were vague and evasive, so Lady Rokujo found it hard to decide what she should do.

units.source_text: 祓禊那天为欲散心而出游，却受到了无情的打击，从此她对万事都厌恶，心中忧思无限。

en.t: On the day of the purification rites, she went out hoping to distract herself, but suffered a cruel blow; from then on she loathed everything, and her heart was filled with endless sorrow.
